verdict.rationale: A skills collection could plausibly ship a skill-authoring spec, template, or meta-skill, so this axis applies. The evidence lists many workflow skills (TDD, grilling, triage, setup, a skill-finder) and shows that installed skill files are editable. None of it documents a spec, template, or meta-skill that lets an agent author and package a new skill end to end. Editable copies are a user-side workaround and earn no credit.
